qualification.evidence: Final release installation and native DP/QP, pole/cache smoke pass. A later configuration-failure rollback fix passes 66 installer/control tests without changing native artifacts.
qualification.name: CLI installation and ABI

qualification.evidence: 17 final-release forced-mode runs cover external, relocated internal and NLO outputs; maximum symmetric error 1.29e-15. Forced modes do not establish stability acceptance.
qualification.name: Generated Fortran integration

qualification.evidence: Nine native bridge tests include binary128 last-bit transport, 256/384-bit convergence, failed-cache cleanup, bounded QP caching and rank-six mapping. Debug builds; no runtime claim.
qualification.name: QP transport and cache isolation

qualification.evidence: N=1–6, rank six, UV/IR/scaleless and rescue/cache checks pass; finite evaluators and arithmetic are absent. 288 scalar comparisons and byte-identical regeneration pass.
qualification.name: Accelerated poles-only path

qualification.evidence: Both link orders and both initialization orders pass with unchanged NinjaRS dependency revisions. Earlier concurrent-license failure retained; qualification runs are serialized.
qualification.name: Native library coexistence

qualification.evidence: 96 served full/partial DP/QP pairs agree; 12 DP pairs refuse both modes and all 54 QP pairs pass. Partial finite outputs are NaN. Explicit refusals are retained and are not successful accelerated evaluations.
qualification.name: Generated pole diagnostics

qualification.evidence: 59 native records cover DP/QP references, hits, independent checks, modes, topology limits, byte budgets, clear/finalize and reinitialization. Stored and uncached tensors agree at the recorded precision.
qualification.name: Generated cache lifecycle

qualification.evidence: 481,536 bit/IEEE checks pass at each optimization level. Kernel timing improves; stubbed-wrapper gains vary. Physical-amplitude acceptance is separate.
qualification.name: Fortran prefix optimization

qualification.evidence: Default 1e-3 native checks miss one correlated rank-five DP error. At 1e-6 the production rescue block with actual tensor callbacks switches to QP and resolves it; complete physical initialization is outside this isolated check.
qualification.name: Default stability stress case

qualification.evidence: All five reducers pass 19 moderate points; original extreme automatic results remain unqualified. Separate QP diagnostics identify legacy CutTools scalar-cutoff and DP-input limitations; private corrections agree with TIRust within 2.11e-11 and an independent double-pole formula.
qualification.name: Complex-mass stress campaign

qualification.evidence: 24 primary requests give 12 checked completions, 11 rejected/nonfinite streams and one warmup timeout. QP resolves several discrepancies; the EW threshold comparison remains unresolved, and the soft-collinear Born result is nonfinite in every reducer.
qualification.name: Physical stress campaign

qualification.evidence: The main matrix above records the independent physical and paired runtime gates. Completed interface checks do not substitute for those measurements.
qualification.name: Full five-backend acceptance
